approvalTitle: 定时 Agent 与模拟盘条件单实施任务
content:
# Tasks Document

- [ ] 1. Add A-share trading calendar primitives
  - Files: `src/trading-calendar.ts`, `test/trading-calendar.test.ts`
  - Add pure Asia/Shanghai calendar helpers for weekday, minutes-of-day, continuous auction boundaries and preopen schedule comparisons.
  - _Leverage: `src/trading-utils.ts`, deterministic clock fixtures_
  - _Requirements: 2.2, 3.5, 5.2_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TypeScript market-calendar engineer | Task: Add pure A-share trading calendar helpers that scheduler and conditional orders can share, with deterministic boundary tests for weekdays, weekends, 09:29/09:30, 11:30, 13:00 and 15:00 | Restrictions: Do not add holiday network calls; do not duplicate timezone logic in UI; keep the file below 250 non-blank lines; write failing tests before implementation | _Leverage: src/trading-utils.ts, test/trading.test.ts | _Requirements: 2.2, 3.5, 5.2 | Success: Calendar helpers are pure, exported, type-safe and prove all required session boundaries | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 2. Implement persisted agent task scheduler
  - Files: `src/agent-automation-store.ts`, `src/agent-scheduler.ts`, `test/agent-scheduler.test.ts`
  - Add automation settings persistence and the scheduler core for daily preopen and interval intraday events.
  - _Leverage: `src/auto-refresh.ts`, `src/json-file.ts`, `src/trading-calendar.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: scheduler runtime engineer | Task: Implement an injectable-clock, injectable-timer scheduler that emits preopen and intraday Agent system events, persists enabled/preopen-time/interval settings, skips overlap, handles sleep catch-up once, and cleans all timers | Restrictions: Do not start timers in constructors; do not call AgentController directly; expose an event-sink interface for the later dispatcher; scheduler failures must not kill the timer; keep each source file below 250 non-blank lines | _Leverage: src/auto-refresh.ts, src/json-file.ts, test/auto-refresh.test.ts | _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.5 | Success: Fake-clock tests prove daily preopen, 5-minute intraday default, non-session suppression, manual run, overlap skip, missed-run catch-up, settings persistence and stop/dispose cleanup | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 3. Add serial Agent event dispatcher
  - Files: `src/agent-controller.ts`, `src/agent-event-dispatcher.ts`, `test/agent-event-dispatcher.test.ts`
  - Add a serial system-event queue with dedupe keys and expose Agent busy state safely.
  - _Leverage: `AgentController.prompt`, `AgentController.waitForIdle`_
  - _Requirements: 1.5, 2.6, 3.2, 3.4, 6.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Agent runtime concurrency engineer | Task: Add a serial AgentEventDispatcher that queues system events, dedupes pending keys, waits for user prompts to finish, records enqueue outcomes and cancels pending events on dispose | Restrictions: Do not bypass AgentController.prompt; do not drop condition events merely because Agent is busy; do not add a broad event bus; keep AgentController behavior backward compatible and each source file below 250 non-blank lines | _Leverage: src/agent-controller.ts, test/agent-controller.test.ts | _Requirements: 1.5, 2.6, 3.2, 3.4, 6.3 | Success: Tests prove FIFO dispatch, no concurrent prompt calls, dedupe, busy waiting, cancellation, abort/wait on dispose and error isolation between events | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 4. Add conditional order model and pure evaluator
  - Files: `src/conditional-orders.ts`, `src/trading.ts`, `test/conditional-orders.test.ts`
  - Add condition types, input validation, state validation, pure quote/time evaluation and a read-only trading lot-size accessor.
  - _Leverage: `src/market-code.ts`, `src/market-data.ts`, `src/trading.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 4.1-4.6, 5.1-5.5_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: trading-domain engineer | Task: Implement price, change-percent and time conditional order models plus a pure evaluator that handles expiry, disabled statuses, market-open checks, evidence timestamps, once/repeat policy and cooldown dedupe | Restrictions: Evaluator must be side-effect free; do not call PaperTradingService.execute; only add a read-only lotSize accessor to trading; preserve A-share red/up green/down and overseas analysis-only boundaries | _Leverage: src/market-code.ts, src/market-data.ts, src/trading.ts, test/trading.test.ts | _Requirements: 4.1-4.6, 5.1-5.5 | Success: Tests cover all condition types, invalid inputs, non-positive/missing quotes, stale timestamps, expiry, pause/cancel, once triggers, repeat cooldown and overseas trade rejection | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 5. Implement conditional order store and service
  - Files: `src/conditional-order-store.ts`, `src/conditional-order-service.ts`, `test/conditional-order-service.test.ts`
  - Add atomic persistence, CRUD, active-code listing, snapshot/clock evaluation and Agent wake prompts.
  - _Leverage: `src/json-file.ts`, `src/paper-account-store.ts`, `src/conditional-orders.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 4.2-4.7, 5.1-5.6_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: local trading service engineer | Task: Implement ConditionalOrderService with atomic versioned persistence, safe corrupt-file recovery, create/list/cancel/pause/resume, active code reporting, snapshot and clock handling, trigger history and evidence-rich Agent system events | Restrictions: Never execute trades from the service; persist trigger state before enqueueing Agent; preserve history on status changes; cap history; do not let corrupted storage crash the app or touch paper-account data | _Leverage: src/json-file.ts, src/paper-account-store.ts, src/agent-scheduler.ts, test/paper-account-store.test.ts | _Requirements: 4.2-4.7, 5.1-5.6 | Success: Tests prove CRUD, persistence restart, corrupt recovery, active codes, price/change/time triggers, trigger-before-enqueue ordering, history retention, repeat cooldown and no direct trade execution | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 6. Wire automation into application lifecycle and market refresh
  - Files: `src/automation-runtime.ts`, `src/app.ts`, `src/command-context.ts`, `test/main.test.ts`
  - Compose scheduler, dispatcher, stores and condition service; expose them through CommandContext; include active condition codes in market refresh and clean up on dispose.
  - _Leverage: `src/app.ts`, `src/main.ts`, `src/agent-scheduler.ts`, `src/conditional-order-service.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.5, 5.6, 6.3_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: application lifecycle engineer | Task: Create an automation runtime composition module and wire scheduler/dispatcher/conditional orders into MarketIntelligenceApp startup, market refresh, CommandContext and dispose without starting timers in constructors | Restrictions: Keep app.ts below 250 non-blank lines by moving composition to automation-runtime; do not replace existing 15s/60s refresh semantics; condition evaluation must not block rendering; dispose must stop timers, cancel pending events, abort and wait for Agent before extension disposal | _Leverage: src/app.ts, src/main.ts, src/command-context.ts, test/main.test.ts, test/market-refresh.test.ts | _Requirements: 1.1-1.5, 2.1-2.6, 3.1-3.5, 5.6, 6.3 | Success: Integration tests prove TUI-start activation, merged market codes, refresh-triggered evaluation, context access and leak-free dispose | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 7. Render compact automation status in the Agent panel
  - Files: `src/automation-status.ts`, `src/app-render.ts`, `src/components/agent.ts`, `test/agent.test.ts`
  - Add an AutomationStatusView and render next run/condition count in the Agent context line without breaking width constraints.
  - _Leverage: `src/width.ts`, `src/components/agent.ts`, `src/app-render.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 3.1, 3.4, 6.3; Usability_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: TUI visualization engineer | Task: Render a compact Chinese automation status in the existing Agent panel header/context area, including enabled state, next task, last result and condition counts | Restrictions: Do not add a workspace; every visible line must fit supplied width; preserve Agent scrolling, command palette and input line; red/up green/down convention untouched; source files below 250 non-blank lines | _Leverage: src/width.ts, src/components/agent.ts, src/app-render.ts, test/agent.test.ts, test/workspace.test.ts | _Requirements: 3.1, 3.4, 6.3; Usability | Success: Tests prove narrow and wide panels show status without overflow and existing Agent rendering behavior remains intact | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 8. Add schedule and conditional order commands
  - Files: `src/automation-commands.ts`, `src/commands.ts`, `test/commands.test.ts`
  - Add Chinese `/schedule` and `/condition` commands for status, settings, manual runs, creation, cancellation, pause and resume.
  - _Leverage: `src/commands.ts`, `src/trading-commands.ts`, `CommandContext`_
  - _Requirements: 3.1-3.4, 4.3-4.4, 6.1_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: terminal command engineer | Task: Add /schedule status/on/off/preopen/interval/run and /condition list/price/change/time/cancel/pause/resume commands using existing command result conventions | Restrictions: Validate all arguments and return Chinese command errors; do not perform trades; preserve APP_COMMANDS behavior by extending tests; no network calls beyond existing quote resolution | _Leverage: src/commands.ts, src/trading-commands.ts, test/commands.test.ts, test/command-window.test.ts | _Requirements: 3.1-3.4, 4.3-4.4, 6.1 | Success: Command tests cover help/status/settings/manual run/all condition forms/status transitions and invalid input without state mutation | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 9. Expose conditional orders to Agent and update prompts
  - Files: `src/condition-agent-tools.ts`, `src/agent-tools.ts`, `src/pi-agent.ts`, `test/agent-tools.test.ts`
  - Add `manage_condition_order` and system-prompt guidance for scheduled and condition-triggered events.
  - _Leverage: `src/agent-tools.ts`, `src/pi-agent.ts`, `src/conditional-order-service.ts`_
  - _Requirements: 1.4, 2.4-2.5, 4.6-4.7, 6.2-6.4_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: Agent tool engineer | Task: Add a zod-validated manage_condition_order tool and update Pi Agent instructions so scheduled and condition events are treated as system tasks, use real tools, preserve reset protection and never claim unexecuted trades | Restrictions: Keep createAStockAgentTools below the source line cap by using a new tool module; preserve existing tool order except appending new tools; do not add real-broker language; condition tool must use explicit service mutations | _Leverage: src/agent-tools.ts, src/pi-agent.ts, test/agent-tools.test.ts, test/pi-agent.test.ts | _Requirements: 1.4, 2.4-2.5, 4.6-4.7, 6.2-6.4 | Success: Tests prove tool schema/actions/results, invalid action rejection, reset gating unchanged and prompt semantics for system-triggered tasks | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._

- [ ] 10. Verify scheduled Agent and condition workflows end to end
  - Files: `test/automation-e2e.test.ts`
  - Add deterministic end-to-end coverage for preopen, intraday, condition-triggered Agent decisions, restart recovery and shutdown cleanup.
  - _Leverage: fake clocks, fake schedulers, scripted Agent drivers, temporary data directories_
  - _Requirements: All_
  - _Prompt: Implement the task for spec scheduled-agent-conditions, first run spec-workflow-guide to get the workflow guide then implement the task: Role: automation QA engineer | Task: Add deterministic end-to-end tests that drive the app through preopen planning, intraday checks, price/change/time condition triggers, Agent execution or refusal, restart recovery and dispose cleanup | Restrictions: No AI provider calls, no real network, no real timers or wall-clock sleeps; assert observable Agent prompts, tool events, account state, persisted conditions and timer cleanup; keep all TUI lines within width | _Leverage: test/main.test.ts, test/command-window.test.ts, test/agent-controller.test.ts, test/trading.test.ts | _Requirements: All | Success: End-to-end tests fail on missing wakeups, duplicate triggers, direct trade bypass, lost persistence, account mutation after refusal or timer leaks; bun run check passes | Before starting mark this task [-] in tasks.md; after implementation log artifacts with spec-workflow log-implementation; then mark this task [x] in tasks.md._
